title: tabernaemontana balansae var. macrophylla
intro: Tabernaemontana balansae var. macrophylla, commonly known as the 'Large-leaved Tabernaemontana', is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant is reported to have various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Tabernaemontana balansae var. macrophylla include its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and exhibit analgesic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties, including the presence of voacangine and voacristine.
